dedupe_keys.name: medellin lorawan path loss with environmental variables

description: The University of Medellín research team publishes LoRaWAN radio measurements with environmental variables from four end nodes within the city of Medellín, Colombia. Nodes lie two to eight kilometres from one gateway. The repository documents 990,750 observations dated October 2021 to March 2022, sampled about every fifteen seconds. Fields include received signal strength, signal-to-noise ratio, antenna geometry, link-budget terms, weather, fine particles and calculated transmission energy. GitHub provides the dataset and a field dictionary; the describing article assigns CC BY 4.0 and access is free. The data can calibrate wireless propagation and energy-use simulations. One gateway and four locations are a limitation on transfer, and the README inconsistently calls the date interval four months. Payload encoding and completeness were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Medellin LoRaWAN path loss with environmental variables
notes: G4-0462; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
